text: Anthropic just dropped 11 free plugins that turn Clawd into an expert at your job. Every plugin is built for a specific job role like sales, marketing, finance, legal, product management, and more, and all of them come with their own sets of skills. And the best part is that they're built on how Anthropic's own team actually does these tasks, so Clawd will follow the same workflows that they use internally. So if you're in sales, it'll research your prospects, prep you for calls, and even draft your own outreach. And if you're in marketing, it'll plan your campaigns, write your email sequences, and even run a full SEO audit. If you're in finance, it'll keep track of every transaction helping to build your financial statements really easily. Plus, it'll connect directly to the tools you already use for your job, like HubSpot, Notion, and Slack, so it gets all the real-time information that it needs. So if you want the full list, just comment, plug in down below, and I'll send you the link directly.
